name: Tanzawa-Oyama Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Tanzawa mountains and Mt. Oyama west of Tokyo, a rugged hiking range with the Oyama Afuri shrine and views over the Kanto plain.
notes: Managed by Kanagawa. Oyama's cable car and the Tanzawa ridge trails are the draws.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.name: 丹沢大山国定公園
ja.description: 東京西方の丹沢山地と大山を中心とする国定公園。険しい登山道と大山阿夫利神社、関東平野の眺望が特徴。
ja.notes: 神奈川県管理。大山のケーブルカーと丹沢の稜線トレイルが見どころ。
